WITH dept_school AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    sc.SCHOOL_CODE,
    sc.SCHOOL_NAME,
    d.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME
  FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d
  JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad
    ON ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd
    ON cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc
    ON sc.SUBJECT_CODE = cd.COURSE
),
phone_counts AS (
  SELECT
    d.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER) AS distinct_phone_numbers
  FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d
  JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad
    ON ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
),
level_counts AS (
  SELECT
    d.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS u_cnt,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS g_cnt
  FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d
  JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd
    ON cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
)
SELECT
  ds.SCHOOL_CODE,
  ds.SCHOOL_NAME,
  ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  COALESCE(pc.distinct_phone_numbers, 0) AS distinct_phone_numbers,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(lc.u_cnt, 0) >= COALESCE(lc.g_cnt, 0) THEN 'Undergraduate'
    ELSE 'Graduate'
  END AS most_common_course_level
FROM dept_school ds
LEFT JOIN phone_counts pc
  ON pc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE
LEFT JOIN level_counts lc
  ON lc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE
ORDER BY
  ds.SCHOOL_CODE,
  ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE;	----- bird -----	dw

WITH dlc_base AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    su.DLC_KEY,
    fo.DLC_NAME
  FROM SPACE_UNIT su
  LEFT JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo
    ON fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY
  WHERE su.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL
),
space_agg AS (
  SELECT
    su.DLC_KEY,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sd.FLOOR_KEY) AS total_floors,
    SUM(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS total_square_footage,
    COUNT(DISTINCT su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS total_facility_organizations,
    SUM(CASE WHEN fb.BUILDING_HEIGHT IS NULL OR TRIM(fb.BUILDING_HEIGHT) = '' THEN 0 ELSE CAST(fb.BUILDING_HEIGHT AS DECIMAL(18,2)) END) AS total_building_heights
  FROM SPACE_UNIT su
  JOIN SPACE_DETAIL sd
    ON sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY
  LEFT JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb
    ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = sd.BUILDING_COMPONENT
  GROUP BY su.DLC_KEY
),
supervisor_agg AS (
  SELECT
    su.DLC_KEY,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ssu.MIT_ID) AS total_supervisors,
    SUM(ssu.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS total_supervisees
  FROM SPACE_UNIT su
  JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE ssu
    ON ssu.DEPT_NAMES = su.DLC_KEY
  GROUP BY su.DLC_KEY
)
SELECT
  db.DLC_KEY,
  db.DLC_NAME,
  COALESCE(sa.total_floors, 0) AS total_floors,
  COALESCE(sa.total_square_footage, 0) AS total_square_footage,
  COALESCE(sa.total_facility_organizations, 0) AS total_facility_organizations,
  COALESCE(sva.total_supervisors, 0) AS total_supervisors,
  COALESCE(sva.total_supervisees, 0) AS total_supervisees,
  COALESCE(sa.total_building_heights, 0) AS total_building_heights
FROM dlc_base db
LEFT JOIN space_agg sa
  ON sa.DLC_KEY = db.DLC_KEY
LEFT JOIN supervisor_agg sva
  ON sva.DLC_KEY = db.DLC_KEY
ORDER BY db.DLC_KEY;	----- bird -----	dw

SELECT
    t.TERM_CODE AS term_code,
    t.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS term_description,
    CASE
        WHEN YEAR(t.TERM_START_DATE) = YEAR(CURDATE()) AND p.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' THEN 'Y'
        ELSE 'N'
    END AS is_current_term,
    (
        (CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c
            WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = t.ACADEMIC_YEAR
              AND c.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y'
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        +
        (CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c
            WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = t.ACADEMIC_YEAR
              AND c.IS_OFFERED_IAP = 'Y'
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        +
        (CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c
            WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = t.ACADEMIC_YEAR
              AND c.IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM = 'Y'
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        +
        (CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c
            WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = t.ACADEMIC_YEAR
              AND c.IS_OFFERED_SUMMER_TERM = 'Y'
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    ) AS distinct_offered_term_types_count
FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t
LEFT JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER p
    ON p.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE
ORDER BY t.TERM_START_DATE, t.TERM_CODE;	----- bird -----	dw

    ON fr.BUILDING_KEY = fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY

    ON fo.ORGANIZATION_KEY = fr.ORGANIZATION_KEY
GROUP BY
    b.BUILDING_NAME,
    b.BUILDING_NUMBER,
    fb.BUILDING_HEIGHT,
    b.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS,
    fba.CITY,
    fba.STATE,
    fo.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME,
